name: Lutfi Afansyah
bio: Lutfi Afansyah Wijaya is an Indonesian content creator and TikTok star known for his humorous, spontaneous, and corporate-themed videos.

credits.title: Lagi Probation: Kerja Ngejar Apa Sih?
credits.overview: Driven by family duty, a desperate young woman lands a competitive probation spot at a corporate seasoning giant, only to find her newly formed workplace friendships shattered when it is revealed that six ambitious interns must battle it out for a single permanent position.

credits.title: Pelan-Pelan Sayang
credits.overview: Kev and Manda are trying to shape their future together, while Kev is also starting his own travel business. Everything changes when Lutesha, a new employee, arrives bringing ideas and a new spark into Kev’s world, threatening his long-time relationship.
